exposure: Implementation of a colostrum-kit clinical routine
outcome: Time from birth to first colostrum administered to the infant
cohort: The study included 3618 infants born at 22 + 0 - 43 + 0 weeks gestational age, admitted to the NICU within 1 hour from birth at a tertiary care hospital in Sweden.
finding: Implementing a colostrum-kit for infants admitted to the NICU significantly reduced the time to first colostrum administered to the infant across all gestational ages.
mod_finding: The difference in time to first colostrum between subgroups of vaginal and caesarean section births was reduced after the implementation of the colostrum-kit, with both groups showing significant reductions in time to first colostrum.
